header.source: NSE closing price (end of day, not live); 52-week range computed from daily highs and lows (NSE bhavcopy)

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Persistent Systems (NSE: PERSISTENT) sells software engineering and IT services to clients in banking and financial services, healthcare and life sciences, and software and high-tech; its consolidated revenue in FY26 was ₹14,748 crore.

claims.label: CALCULATION
claims.text: In the quarter to 30 Sep 2026, revenue was ₹4,664 crore, 30.3% more than a year earlier; the operating margin was 10.0% against 16.3%, and profit attributable to shareholders was ₹352 crore, 25.4% lower.

claims.label: CALCULATION
claims.text: On 16 Oct 2026, the first session after the result, PERSISTENT shares fell 1.70% while the NIFTY 50 rose 0.65% and the NIFTY IT index rose 3.92%; allowing for the market's move, PERSISTENT's own move was -2.28%, about 1.10 times its usual daily variation.

claims.label: UNCERTAIN
claims.text: These numbers measure the move, not its cause: the result, the IT sector's rise and any other news that day overlap, and nothing here separates them.

claims.label: CALCULATION
claims.text: At ₹6,282 (NSE close, 23 Nov 2026), a discounted cash flow model with a 12.09% cost of capital does not reach the price at any revenue growth up to 30% a year for five years at the FY26 operating margin of 16.2%; with revenue growing at its FY23–FY26 rate of 20.9%, it does at an operating margin of 29.3%.

claims.label: CALCULATION
claims.text: That three-year rate is held down by FY24's 17.6%; the two years since grew 21.6% and 23.5%.

claims.label: CALCULATION
claims.text: With the other assumptions at base, the valuation is most sensitive to the cost of capital (one percentage point either way: a model value of ₹2,889 to ₹4,021 a share) and to the operating margin (two percentage points either way: a model value of ₹2,925 to ₹3,818 a share); the Q3 FY27 result will be the next reported quarter.

prices.note: Each series is rebased to 100 on the first common session. Raw exchange prices are not published here (NSE terms).

metrics.label: Market cap
metrics.definition: Price × shares outstanding (share capital ÷ ₹5 face value at 2026-09-30).

metrics.label: P/E (TTM)
metrics.definition: Price ÷ earnings per share over the last four reported quarters (Q3 FY26 – Q2 FY27).

metrics.label: EV / EBIT (TTM)
metrics.definition: Enterprise value (market cap − the net cash and treasury figure below) ÷ operating profit over the last four quarters.

metrics.label: Net cash and treasury
metrics.definition: Cash, bank balances and treasury investments, less lease liabilities, preference shares and minority interests, at 30 Sep 2026.

metrics.label: Operating margin (FY26)
metrics.definition: EBIT ÷ revenue, after depreciation, excluding other income. Sites that quote an EBITDA-based margin show a higher figure.

metrics.label: ROE (FY26)
metrics.definition: Profit for the year ÷ total equity at year end.

metrics.label: ROIC (FY26)
metrics.definition: After-tax EBIT ÷ invested capital at the start of the year. Invested capital excludes about ₹2k crore of cash and treasury, which is why it looks so high.

metrics.label: Revenue growth FY23–FY26
metrics.definition: Compound annual growth of revenue from FY23 to FY26. FY24 alone grew only 17.6%; the two years since grew more.

metrics.label: Cash conversion (FY26)
metrics.definition: Operating cash flow ÷ profit for the year.

metrics.label: Beta vs NIFTY 50
metrics.definition: Sensitivity of PERSISTENT's daily return to the NIFTY 50's, over the two years to the price date.

flags.title: The price is beyond what the model can reach
flags.text: The model cannot reach the price at any revenue growth up to 30% a year, so the page says 'more than 30%' instead of forcing a number. This is a statement about the model's range and assumptions, not a forecast and not a view on the shares.

flags.title: The exchange's files contain errors
flags.text: 29 reconciliation checks fail on the exchange's own files, each with a recorded reason. They are marked as explained, not passed, and the figure as filed is used, never a corrected one.

flags.title: Owners' profit taken from the printed results for three quarters
flags.text: The exchange files leave the owners' share of profit blank for the December 2024 and June 2026 quarters and put total comprehensive income on that line for June 2025. For those quarters it is set equal to profit for the period, because the company reports no non-controlling interests (a derivation, labelled as such).

flags.title: Capital expenditure differs between filings
flags.text: The exchange file for FY26 files capital expenditure and the proceeds from selling property under each other's tags, and later results documents restate the capital expenditure of FY24 and FY25 against the earlier exchange files. Where two filings disagree the latest published figure is used, taken from the printed cash-flow statement, and the check is shown as a warning, not as passed.

limitations: Template A (non-financial, positive free cash flow). Single-stage fade model; no currency driver.
Cash flows are discounted to the balance-sheet date, 30 Sep 2026, two months before the price date; the model does not roll that gap forward, so its values are slightly low against the price.
The base growth anchor includes FY24's unusually weak year; later years grew faster.
Leases are the only debt; earmarked bank balances are counted as cash, which overstates cash slightly.
The risk-free rate is a twelve-month average while the price and equity risk premium are point-in-time.
The event study measures the size of a move, not its cause; five results days are too few for statistical claims.

Persistent's exchange XBRL files carry several tagging errors on the line for profit attributable to owners: it is blank for the December 2024 and June 2026 quarters, and holds total comprehensive income for the June 2025 quarter. For those periods the owners' profit is set equal to the printed profit for the period, because the company reports no non-controlling interests (a derivation, labelled as such). The errors are listed, not corrected, in the reconciliation report.
Persistent's results are printed in INR million; lines taken from its results PDFs are converted to INR crore by the engine.
Before the March 2026 year end the XBRL files fold lease liabilities into other financial liabilities; the lease lines for March 2022 to September 2025 come from the results PDFs.
The shares were split from a face value of 10 rupees to 5 rupees in March 2024; the price history is adjusted for it.

At the valuation date the model does not reach the share price at any revenue growth inside the range it searches at the latest operating margin. That is a statement about the model's range and assumptions, not a view on the shares.
Static page: prices are end-of-day as of the date shown, not live.
